title: A fresh cloud runner checking a child repo fetches the claude-settings commit the child's lint pins, with no hand steps
why: A fresh cloud runner lacks the claude-settings commit a child repo's lint pins (q_max pins 2ac382c), so its checks fail until it fetches that commit and sets CLAUDE_SETTINGS_DIR by hand. Every fresh child-repo runner hits this.
source: coordinator 23:17 CST Nov 11, from batch runner 11 at 23:16 CST
note: Related: R44 (child CI follows the claude-settings stable branch) and step child-repo-gap; neither covers a runner fetching the pinned commit, so it is its own step. Fold it into the stable-branch work if that removes per-child pins.
